subject: [hw] DONE IV rev 4: fake VENC session on the plain tree -> valid 320x240 H.264 (115841 B); IV 72/72; run_session passes
body:
DONE IV rev 4 (host only; no phone, nothing published). The fake VENC session is in the runner and produces a valid H.264 frame.

  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
  N2VHOST fake VENC model on (log /tmp/n2hw-iv/run/venc-fake.txt)
  N2VHOST encode seq-hdr bytes=29 key=0
  N2VHOST encode frame fds=1 bytes=115812 key=1
  N2VHOST encode final rc=0 bytes=0
  N2VHOST bitstream /tmp/n2hw-iv/run/bitstream-320x240.h264 115841 bytes
  N2VHOST fake-venc resets=1 triggers=1 frames=1 irqs=1/1 acks=1 ... headers=1 last_bytes=115812 mb=20x15
  N2VHOST M-d ... n2ap_venc_open returned 0
  N2VHOST M-e first VENC window access: write VENC 0x00a8 0x00000000
  N2VHOST M-f wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=3 venc_ops=64 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=14
  N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)

  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh      # root's acceptance, PLAIN tree
  run_session: apply_patches: OK                  (every block ALREADY/SKIP except the redundant V41 wait_output)
  run_session: N2VHOST encode frame fds=1 bytes=115812 key=1
  run_vhost.sh: .../bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)

  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST IV PASS 72/72

  Affected suites: N2TEST V40 PASS 1437/1437, V41 PASS 630/630, V34 PASS 2044/2044 (+V34CORE 103/103), fakevenc PASS 3/3, V40-IOS 1/1. build_ios.sh: vcodecd: linked (391536 B).

What IV applied to its own files (root item "host/Makefile + n2vhost.c"): fakevenc/n2venc_fake.c built and wrapped around T02's fake (hw_used for the VCU/AP, `hw` kept for T02's controls), fake-venc counters printed, SEQ_HDR -> one IDR (fds 0x500/0x501) -> EOS FRAME_FINAL, VENC/VENC_C1 powered per job through V41's n2ap_venc_power, async size through n2ap_venc_wait_done. The fake model is filtered out of libn2vhost.a and the iOS archive so the daemon never carries it.
On "add run_session.sh to run_vhost.sh": run_session.sh calls run_vhost.sh inside a /tmp copy, so a literal call would recurse; run_vhost.sh now performs the same full session and validates the stream itself, and run_session.sh passes on the tree. Say if you meant a different wiring.

Other carry items integrated while making it pass (owners have the same text): V41 post-encode ven_put_buffer + EOS FINAL without frame + from_device sync; V34 ION_SYS_CACHE_SYNC guest<->device copy (without it the checker found no SPS; headers learned went 0 -> 1). TSan: one suppression only, the guest-shared venc_vsi.list_free ring (ap/test_v41/tsan.supp, host/test_iv/tsan.supp); every other race is a finding.

Not done: one 320x240 session (I_PCM/CAVLC/4:2:0), no HEVC/P frames/decode/rate control; real stream still needs the phone. Full output: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md. Staying available for review.
